info.title: Kahuna.Server
info.description: Kahuna server node — distributed key-value store, lock manager and sequencer. Run `kahuna-server` to start a standalone node.

options.name: --host
options.description:
(Default: *) Host to
bind incoming
connections to

options.name: --http-ports
options.description:
Ports to bind incoming
HTTP connections to

options.name: --https-ports
options.description:
Ports to bind incoming
HTTPs connections to

options.name: --grpc-cleartext-ports
options.description:
Ports to bind cleartext
HTTP/2 (h2c)
connections to.
gRPC-only: these
listeners speak HTTP/2
without TLS and reject
HTTP/1.1, so REST
clients must use the
http/https ports
instead. A standalone
node defaults to 2072;
a node joining a
cluster binds nothing
unless this option is
given

options.name: --https-certificate
options.description:
Path to the HTTPs
certificate

options.name: --https-certificate-password
options.description:
(Default: ) Password of
the HTTPs certificate

options.name: --disable-dashboard
options.description:
Do not serve the
browser operator
dashboard at the HTTP
root

options.name: --dashboard-refresh-seconds
options.description:
(Default: 5) How often
the dashboard polls
this node, in seconds
(1-300)

options.name: --advertised-client-endpoint
options.description:
(Default: ) Base URL
this node advertises to
clients in routing
hints (e.g.
https://node1:8082).
Empty derives it from
the Raft endpoint and

options.name: --advertised-client-sch
options.description:
eme; a deployment whose
Raft address is not
client-reachable must
set it explicitly

options.name: --advertised-client-scheme
options.description:
(Default: ) URL scheme
prepended to a peer's
Raft endpoint when a
routing hint names that
peer. Empty follows

options.name: --raft-grpc-scheme
options.description: URL scheme prepended to peer endpoints when opening gRPC channels

options.name: --disable-peer-endpoint-advertisement
options.description:
Never name a peer in a
routing hint. Set it
where a peer's client
URL cannot be derived
from its Raft endpoint,
so clients learn only
routes that name the
answering node

options.name: --disable-routing-hints
options.description:
Do not return advisory
routing hints on
responses. Clients then
keep their configured
endpoint selection

options.name: --storage
options.description:
(Default: rocksdb)
Storage (rocksdb,
sqlite, memory)

options.name: --storage-path
options.description: Storage path

options.name: --storage-revision
options.description: Storage revision

options.name: --wal-storage
options.description:
(Default: rocksdb) WAL
storage (rocksdb,

options.name: --wal-path
options.description: WAL path

options.name: --wal-revision
options.description:
(Default: v1) WAL
revision

options.name: --wal-sync-writes
options.description:
Use synchronous durable
WAL writes (default:
enabled)

options.name: --disable-wal-sync-writes
options.description:
Disable synchronous
durable WAL writes for
faster non-critical
test/local runs

options.name: --rocksdb-shared-memory
options.description:
Share one RocksDB block
cache + write-buffer
manager between the
KV/locks backend and
the Raft WAL (requires
both storage and
wal-storage = rocksdb).
Default: disabled

options.name: --rocksdb-shared-memory-budget-mb
options.description:
(Default: 320) Total
shared RocksDB
block-cache budget in
MiB (memtable
sub-budget lives inside
it)

options.name: --rocksdb-shared-memtable-budget-mb
options.description:
(Default: 128) Shared
RocksDB memtable
sub-budget in MiB,
cost-charged into the
shared cache (must be
<= budget)

options.name: --disable-rocksdb-direct-reads
options.description:
Disable direct-I/O
reads (default:
enabled) and use
buffered reads backed
by the OS page cache

options.name: --rocksdb-statistics
options.description:
Enable RocksDB
statistics collection
and periodic LOG dumps
(adds per-operation
overhead; for
tuning/diagnosis).

options.name: --initial-cluster
options.description:
Initial cluster
configuration for
static discovery
the seed list. When
false (default) the
node boots via static

options.name: --join-existing
options.description:
(Default: false) Join a
running cluster as a
new node using

options.name: --graceful-leave-on-shutdown
options.description:
(Default: false) On
planned shutdown,
commit a RemoveMember
so the roster shrinks
immediately rather than
waiting for SWIM
eviction. Default
false; do not enable on
rolling restarts.

options.name: --initial-cluster-partitions
options.description:
(Default: 3) Initial
cluster number of
partitions

options.name: --raft-nodename
options.description:
Unique name to identify
the node in the cluster

options.name: --raft-nodeid
options.description: Unique id to identify

options.name: --raft-host
options.description:
(Default: localhost)
Host to listen for Raft
consensus and
replication requests

options.name: --raft-port
options.description:
(Default: 2070) Port to
bind incoming Raft

options.name: --locks-workers
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
lock
ephemeral/consistent
workers (0 = auto-size:
max(32, CPU cores x 4))

options.name: --keyvalue-workers
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
key/value

options.name: --background-writer-workers
options.description:
(Default: 1) Number of
background writers
workers

options.name: --sequencer-workers
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
sequence workers (0 =
auto-size: max(8, CPU
cores))

options.name: --sequencer-block-size
options.description:
(Default: 1000) Values
reserved per sequence
compare-and-swap; one
Raft commit is
amortized over this
many values. 1 =
gap-free (one commit
per value)

options.name: --sequencer-idempotency-retention-max
options.description:
(Default: 256) Maximum
idempotency entries
retained per sequence
record (0 = no cap)

options.name: --sequencer-idempotency-retention-ttl
options.description:
(Default: 600) Window
(in seconds) within
which retrying a keyed
sequence reserve
replays the identical
allocation (0 = no age
pruning)

options.name: --sequencer-max-sequences-per-actor
options.description:
(Default: 10000)
Maximum sequences one
actor keeps resident
before evicting the
least recently used (0
= unbounded)

options.name: --sequencer-block-lease
options.description:
(Default: 5) Seconds a
reserved sequence block
may be served from
memory before it is
revalidated against the
durable record (0 =
never revalidate)

options.name: --default-transaction-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 5000) Default
transaction timeout (in
milliseconds)

options.name: --default-admission-wait
options.description:
(Default: 5000)
Milliseconds a caller
queues for an admission
slot when it does not
request its own budget;
this is the wait to
start a transaction,
not the transaction's
lifetime

options.name: --max-admission-wait
options.description:
(Default: 30000) Hard
upper bound (in
milliseconds) on any
admission wait, so no
caller can hold a queue
slot longer than this

options.name: --max-concurrent-transactions
options.description:
(Default: 0) Script
transactions that may
execute concurrently
before further ones
queue and start in
priority order (0 = no
limit)

options.name: --max-concurrent-sessions
options.description:
(Default: 0)
Interactive transaction
sessions that may be
open concurrently (0 =
no limit)

options.name: --transaction-priority-reserved-slots
options.description:
(Default: 0) Slots out
of each concurrency
ceiling that only
high/critical priority
transactions may occupy

options.name: --transaction-priority-aging-threshold
options.description:
(Default: 1000)
Milliseconds a queued
transaction waits to
gain one effective
priority level (0 = no
aging)

options.name: --transaction-priority-max-queued
options.description:
(Default: 4096) Callers
that may wait for an
admission slot per gate
before further ones are
refused retryably (0 =
unbounded)

options.name: --read-io-threads
options.description:
(Default: 4) Read I/O
threads

options.name: --write-io-threads
options.description: (Default: 16) Write I/O

options.name: --backend-read-io-threads
options.description:
(Default: 8) Dedicated
Kahuna backend read
pool threads (point
gets, scans), separate
from the Kommander WAL
read pool

options.name: --backend-write-io-threads
options.description:
(Default: 1) Dedicated
Kahuna
background-writer pool
threads; the writer
uses a single queue so
>1 only adds idle

options.name: --backend-read-queue-depth
options.description:
(Default: 4096)
Per-partition
pending-queue depth for
the Kahuna backend read
scheduler

options.name: --raft-enable-shared-executor-pool
options.description:
(Default: true) Share a
bounded pool of worker
threads across all Raft
partitions instead of
one OS thread per
partition. Required to
run thousands of
partitions (e.g. after
range splits). Disable
only to isolate
scheduler issues.

options.name: --raft-executor-pool-size
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
shared Raft executor
worker threads. 0
auto-sizes to the
processor count. Raise
above the core count
only if ops queue
behind busy partitions
while CPU is not
saturated.

options.name: --raft-http-scheme
options.description:
(Default: https://)
Raft HTTP scheme used
by REST communication

options.name: --raft-http-auth-bearer-token
options.description:
(Default: ) Raft HTTP
bearer token used by
REST communication

options.name: --raft-http-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 5) Raft HTTP
request timeout in
seconds

options.name: --raft-http-version
options.description:
(Default: 2.0) Raft
HTTP version used by

options.name: --raft-heartbeat-interval
options.description:
(Default: 500) Raft
leader heartbeat
interval in
milliseconds

options.name: --raft-recent-heartbeat
options.description:
(Default: 100) Raft
recent heartbeat window
in milliseconds

options.name: --raft-voting-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 1500) Raft
vote wait timeout in

options.name: --raft-leadership-barrier-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 10000) How
long a newly elected
leader waits for its
promotion barrier entry
to commit before
reverting to follower,
in milliseconds. Until
that entry commits the
node heartbeats but
does not serve, so
raising this trades
failover latency for
tolerance of a slow
quorum

options.name: --raft-leadership-confirmation-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 2000) Maximum
time a read-index
leadership confirmation
may wait for the quorum
ack round plus
applied-frontier
catch-up before
failing, in

options.name: --raft-proposal-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 10000) How
long a write caller
waits for a proposal to
reach quorum before the
call returns
ProposalTimeout, in

options.name: --raft-enable-check-quorum
options.description:
(Default: false) When
set, a leader that has
not heard a same-term
append/heartbeat ack
from a majority of
voters for the
check-quorum window
steps down to follower

options.name: --raft-check-quorum-interval-multiplier
options.description:
(Default: 8) Number of
heartbeat intervals
without a majority of
same-term acks after
which a leader with
check-quorum enabled
steps down

options.name: --raft-check-leader-interval
options.description:
(Default: 250) Raft
leader check interval

options.name: --raft-timer-initial-delay
options.description:
(Default: 2500) Initial
delay before Raft
timers start in

options.name: --raft-update-nodes-interval
options.description:
(Default: 5000) Raft
node registry update

options.name: --raft-start-election-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 2000) Raft
minimum election
timeout in milliseconds

options.name: --raft-end-election-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 4000) Raft
maximum election

options.name: --raft-start-election-timeout-increment
options.description:
(Default: 100) Raft
timeout increment in

options.name: --raft-end-election-timeout-increment
options.description: (Default: 200) Raft

options.name: --raft-slow-state-machine-log
options.description:
(Default: 50) Raft
state-machine slow
operation log threshold

options.name: --raft-slow-wal-machine-log
options.description: (Default: 25) Raft WAL

options.name: --raft-invariant-checks
options.description:
Reaction when a Raft
consensus invariant
check fails: Off, Log
(record and continue),
or Throw (crash at the
offending transition).
Diagnostic only; never
changes protocol
behavior. Defaults to
Throw in a debug build
and Log in a release
build

options.name: --raft-compact-every-operations
options.description:
(Default: 10000)
Committed operations
between automatic Raft
WAL compactions

options.name: --raft-compact-number-entries
options.description:
(Default: 100) Raft WAL
entries removed per
compaction batch

options.name: --raft-max-entries-per-compaction
options.description:
(Default: 5000) Maximum
Raft WAL entries to
process per compaction
run

options.name: --raft-election-timeout-seed
options.description:
(Default: 0) Seed for
deterministic Raft
election timeouts (0 =
random, non-zero =
deterministic; for
testing only)

options.name: --raft-max-queued-client-proposals
options.description:
(Default: 2048) Maximum
client proposals queued
per partition before
backpressure kicks in

options.name: --raft-max-wal-queue-depth-per-partition
options.description:
(Default: 4096)
Per-partition WAL write
queue depth limit

options.name: --raft-max-global-wal-queue-depth
options.description:
(Default: 0) Global WAL
write queue depth limit
across all partitions
(0 = unlimited)

options.name: --raft-max-wal-batch-size
options.description:
(Default: 256) Maximum
WAL writes batched per
storage flush

options.name: --raft-max-wal-group-batch-partitions
options.description:
(Default: 64) Maximum
partitions coalesced
into a single WAL
cross-partition
group-commit batch

options.name: --raft-wal-group-commit-linger-ms
options.description:
(Default: 0)
Group-commit linger
window in milliseconds
(0 = disabled; raise on
networks where fsync
rate is the bottleneck)

options.name: --raft-wal-single-fsync-commit
options.description:
(Default: true) Enable
single-fsync fast path:
ack on
propose-quorum-durable
and demote the commit
marker to a lazy write

options.name: --raft-wal-shard-write-buffer-size-mb
options.description:
(Default: 0) Raft WAL
shard memtable size in
MiB (0 = Kommander
default, 64)

options.name: --raft-wal-shard-min-write-buffer-number-to-merge
options.description:
(Default: 0) Immutable
Raft WAL memtables
merged into one flush
(0 = Kommander default,
2)

options.name: --raft-wal-shard-max-write-buffer-number
options.description:
(Default: 0) Maximum
Raft WAL memtables per
shard column family;
must exceed the merge
count (0 = Kommander
default, 4)

options.name: --raft-wal-shard-level0-file-num-compaction-trigger
options.description:
(Default: 0) L0 file
count that triggers
Raft WAL compaction
into the base level (0
= Kommander default, 8)

options.name: --raft-wal-shard-level0-slowdown-writes-trigger
options.description:
(Default: 0) L0 file
count at which Raft WAL
writers are slowed (0 =
Kommander default, 28)

options.name: --raft-wal-shard-level0-stop-writes-trigger
options.description:
(Default: 0) L0 file
writers are stopped (0
= Kommander default,
44)

options.name: --raft-wal-shard-max-bytes-for-level-base-mb
options.description:
(Default: 0)
max_bytes_for_level_bas
e for the Raft WAL
shard column families,
in MiB; sizing it above
the retained log keeps
the live log in the
base level (0 =
Kommander default,
which leaves RocksDB's
256 MiB)

options.name: --raft-wal-shard-universal-compaction
options.description:
(Default: false) Use
universal instead of
leveled compaction for
the Raft WAL shard
column families; makes
the level-base setting
inert

options.name: --raft-sqlite-wal-shard-count
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
SQLite shard databases
across which partitions
are distributed (0 =
resolved to processor
count on first
initialisation)

options.name: --raft-max-drain-quantum-control
options.description:
(Default: 8) Max
control-plane
operations drained per
executor wake cycle

options.name: --raft-max-drain-quantum-replication
options.description:
(Default: 4) Max
replication operations
drained per executor
wake cycle

options.name: --raft-max-drain-quantum-client
options.description: (Default: 2) Max client

options.name: --raft-max-drain-quantum-maintenance
options.description:
(Default: 1) Max
maintenance operations

options.name: --raft-grpc-channels-per-node
options.description:
(Default: 4) Number of
pooled gRPC channels
opened to each peer
node (clamped to [1,
64]). Each channel is a
permanently-held
connection and handler.

options.name: --raft-grpc-enable-multiple-http2-connections
options.description:
(Default: false) Allow
each pooled gRPC
channel to open
multiple HTTP/2
connections to spread
concurrent streams

options.name: --raft-grpc-enable-snapshot-compression
options.description:
(Default: false)
Compress Raft snapshot
transfers sent over
gRPC

options.name: --raft-snapshot-receive-session-ttl
options.description:
(Default: 30000) How
long an idle
snapshot-receive
session is kept before
the receiver discards
it and releases its
buffered bytes, in
milliseconds. Bounds
the memory a leader
that vanishes
mid-transfer can
strand.

options.name: --raft-snapshot-max-pending-sessions
options.description:
(Default: 8) Cap on
concurrent
sessions across all
partitions. Beyond the
cap the receiver evicts
its
least-recently-active
sessions.

options.name: --raft-snapshot-max-pending-bytes
options.description:
(Default: 536870912)
Cap on total buffered
bytes across all
in-progress
sessions. The primary
memory bound on the
receive path.

options.name: --raft-allow-legacy-snapshot-senders
options.description:
(Default: false) Accept
snapshot chunks that
leave the sender's
session-metadata fields
empty, treating them as
a sender that pre-dates
those fields. Temporary
compatibility switch
for a mixed-version
cluster.

options.name: --raft-snapshot-transfer-step-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 120000) Upper
bound on one awaited
step of an outbound
snapshot transfer (an
export call, one stream
read, or one chunk
send), in milliseconds.
A step that makes
progress resets the
clock; only a step that
stalls trips the
timeout.

options.name: --raft-max-pre-auth-request-body-bytes
options.description:
(Default: 33554432)
Ceiling on a Raft REST
request body before it
is
authenticated/signed,
in bytes. Bounds
buffering independent
of the host's own
request-size limit.

options.name: --raft-backfill-enabled
options.description:
(Default: true) Whether
a leader ships catch-up
batches (and falls back
to a snapshot transfer)
to lagging followers.
Turning it off makes a
follower that misses
entries permanently
stale — only set it
false when the
deployment owns its
peers' catch-up story.

options.name: --raft-backfill-threshold
options.description:
(Default: 10) Committed
entries a follower may
trail the leader before
active backfill kicks
in

options.name: --raft-max-backfill-entries-per-round
options.description:
(Default: 128) Maximum
committed entries
shipped to a stale
follower per heartbeat
interval

options.name: --raft-follower-saturation-backoff
options.description:
(Default: 1000) How
long a leader stops
sending backfill
batches to a peer after
that peer reports its
WAL queue saturated, in

options.name: --raft-backfill-no-progress-pause-cap
options.description:
(Default: 30000) Cap on
the exponential pause
between backfill
batches to a follower
whose reported commit
frontier is not
advancing, in

options.name: --raft-backfill-no-progress-anchor-fallback-ships
options.description:
(Default: 2)
Consecutive fruitless
backfill ships after
which the leader
re-anchors the next
batch at the follower's
reported commit
frontier instead of
nextIndex. Values <= 0
disable the fallback

options.name: --raft-learner-promotion-lag
options.description:
(Default: 10) Maximum
entries a learner may
trail the leader and
still be eligible for
promotion

options.name: --raft-learner-promotion-stable-window
options.description:
(Default: 3000)
Milliseconds a learner
must stay within
promotion-lag before
being promoted to Voter

options.name: --raft-gossip-interval
options.description:
(Default: 5000)
Interval between gossip
anti-entropy rounds in

options.name: --raft-gossip-fanout
options.description:
(Default: 2) Number of
random peers contacted
per gossip round (0
disables gossip)

options.name: --raft-ping-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 500) SWIM
failure-detector ping

options.name: --raft-indirect-ping-fanout
options.description:
(Default: 2) Number of
intermediary nodes used
for indirect SWIM
probing

options.name: --raft-suspicion-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 5000) How
long a node may remain
Suspect before being
declared Dead in

options.name: --raft-dead-member-eviction-grace
options.description:
(Default: 30000) Grace
period before a Dead
node is committed as
removed from the roster

options.name: --raft-self-repair-peer-down-grace
options.description:
(Default: 30000) How
long the promotion-gate
self-repair
(gap-skipping committed
drain and orphaned-tail
truncation) defers
while a voter peer is
not Alive, in
milliseconds. 0
disables the grace

options.name: --raft-ping-interval
options.description:
(Default: 1000)
Interval between SWIM
ping rounds in
milliseconds (0
disables the failure
detector). Must be > 0
and <
raft-start-election-tim
eout when quiescence is
enabled.

options.name: --raft-enable-auto-rejoin
options.description:
(Default: true) A node
that finds itself
removed from the
committed roster
(dead-member eviction
firing across a slow
restart) re-runs the
join flow against the
remaining members
instead of staying
NotMember. Disable only
when an operator
workflow removes live
nodes and expects them
to stay out.

options.name: --raft-enable-quiescence
options.description:
(Default: true) Quiesce
idle partitions: a
leader stops
per-partition
heartbeats after a
partition is idle,
relying on the SWIM
failure detector for
node liveness. Cuts
O(NxM) idle heartbeat
traffic across many
partitions. Requires
SWIM
(raft-ping-interval > 0
eout).

options.name: --raft-quiesce-after
options.description:
(Default: 1500) How
long a partition must
be idle (no proposals,
no in-flight
replication) before its
leader quiesces it, in

options.name: --raft-enable-leader-balancer
options.description:
(Default: false) Master
switch for advisory
leader-balancing. When
false (default) no load
reports are built or
gossiped and the
balancer loop never
runs. Enable only after
all cluster nodes
support the feature.

options.name: --raft-leader-balancer-report-interval
options.description:
(Default: 5000) How
often each node emits a
load report on the
gossip path in
milliseconds. Shorter
intervals give fresher
data at the cost of
more gossip traffic.

options.name: --raft-leader-balancer-interval
options.description:
(Default: 30000) How
often the P0 leader
runs a balancer
planning pass and
dispatches leader-move
suggestions in
milliseconds.

options.name: --raft-leader-balancer-report-ttl
options.description:
(Default: 20000)
Maximum age of a node
load report before it
is considered stale and
excluded from planning
in milliseconds. Must
be greater than
raft-leader-balancer-re
port-interval.

options.name: --raft-count-deadband
options.description:
(Default: 1) Minimum
leader-count imbalance
above the ideal
per-node count before
the balancer emits any
moves. Prevents
flip-flopping around
balanced distributions.

options.name: --raft-load-imbalance-threshold
options.description:
(Default: 0.25)
Fractional load skew
threshold
(maxLoad-minLoad)/maxLo
ad between the busiest
and quietest node that
triggers load-tier
swaps when count is
already balanced.

options.name: --raft-min-leader-stability-ms
options.description:
(Default: 5000) How
remain on the same
leader (ms) before it
is eligible to be
moved. Prevents
immediate reshuffling
of a partition after an
election.

options.name: --raft-move-cooldown
options.description:
(Default: 60000) How
long a partition is
excluded from further
moves after a transfer
suggestion in
milliseconds. Prevents
rapid oscillation on
hot partitions.

options.name: --raft-max-moves-per-pass
options.description:
(Default: 4) Maximum
number of leader-move
suggestions emitted in
a single planner pass.
Limits blast radius of
a bad planning
decision.

options.name: --raft-max-concurrent-transfers
options.description:
(Default: 2) Maximum
number of in-flight
transfer suggestions
the P0 leader tracks
simultaneously. No new
moves are dispatched
until outstanding ones
confirm or time out.

options.name: --raft-leader-balancer-ops-weight
options.description:
(Default: 1) Weight of
the EWMA ops/sec term
in the composite
per-partition load
score. Higher values
make the balancer more
sensitive to throughput
differences.

options.name: --raft-leader-balancer-queue-weight
options.description:
(Default: 0.5) Weight
of the instantaneous
queue-depth term in the
composite per-partition
load score. Higher
values make the
balancer more sensitive
to pending-work
backlog.

options.name: --raft-suggestion-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 15000) How
long the P0 leader
waits for a suggested
move to be confirmed
before declaring it
dropped in
milliseconds. After
timeout the partition
is eligible again
subject to
raft-move-cooldown.

options.name: --raft-enable-slow-node-avoidance
options.description:
(Default: false) Master
switch for
degraded-node leader
avoidance. When true,
the balancer classifies
nodes whose WAL commit
wait stands far above
the cluster median as
slow, refuses them as
transfer targets, and
drains the leaderships
they already hold. Acts
only inside the
leader-balancer pass,
so it does nothing
unless
raft-enable-leader-bala
ncer is also true.

options.name: --raft-slow-node-multiplier
options.description:
(Default: 3) How far
above the cluster
median commit wait a
node must sit before it
is a slow candidate.
Must be greater than
1.0.

options.name: --raft-slow-node-floor-ms
options.description:
(Default: 10) Absolute
floor in milliseconds
below which a node is
never a slow candidate,
whatever its ratio to
the median.

options.name: --raft-slow-node-min-samples
options.description:
(Default: 20) Number of
WAL group batches a
node must have observed
before its commit wait
is judged at all. Below
this the node counts as
unknown and is never
drained or excluded.

options.name: --raft-slow-node-observation-ttl
options.description:
(Default: 30000)
Maximum age of a node's
last commit-wait
observation before the
node counts as unknown,
in milliseconds.

options.name: --raft-slow-node-enter-passes
options.description:
(Default: 3)
Consecutive balancer
passes a node must look
slow before it is
classified Slow.

options.name: --raft-slow-node-exit-passes
options.description:
(Default: 6)
Consecutive clean
passes before a
classified slow node is
released. Deliberately
longer than
raft-slow-node-enter-pa
sses to avoid flapping.

options.name: --raft-replication-factor
options.description:
(Default: 0) Desired
number of voter
replicas per partition
range. 0 (the default)
